description: Cluster-level Container Insights opt-in. Enables CloudWatch metrics + log aggregation. 'enhanced' adds container-level metrics (more cost, more detail).
Target % utilization that ECS-driven scaling tries to maintain. <100 keeps slack capacity for fast scale-out at the cost of unused EC2.
Smallest delta ECS will request. Raise to avoid thrashing on small load changes.
Largest delta per scaling event. Lower to throttle large bursts.
How long after instance launch until ECS considers it 'in service' (eligible for tasks). Match to AMI warm-up time + agent registration time.
When ENABLED, ECS sets ASG instance scale-in protection on instances running tasks. Critical to prevent ASG from terminating busy instances during scale-in.
Used by run-task / create-service when no strategy is explicitly given. The base+weight semantics described under capacity-provider concept.
Fargate platform version. 1.4.0+ required for: ephemeralStorage, secret-options, EFS in-transit-encryption, x86_64 runtime improvements. Pin if you need behavioral stability across rotations.
